registryBasis: May 2026 official news reports a 12–14 month Nouakchott property census to create a digital database and urban maps with unique parcel IDs; January 2026 official news describes national cadastre digitization reform and AQAAR. This is direct city-specific registry activity, not an open dataset.
findings: Directly opened official AMI reporting confirms a citywide built-property census launched in Nouakchott on 12 May 2026, intended to create a digital database and urban maps. It describes 12–14 months of field collection and unique parcel IDs; completion and publication are not yet verified. An alternate archived URL timed out without an HTTP response, so the direct current French page is the controlling evidence. No finished public parcel-vector API was identified.
